intro: Real Madrid have completed the signing of Ivory Coast international Yan Diomande from German side RB Leipzig, in a transfer reported by BBC Sport. sections.text:

RB Leipzig are a relatively young presence in German football, established in the late 2000s and competing at the Red Bull Arena; they have been a regular presence in the top tier of the German league system in recent years. Transfers between major European clubs are a normal part of the football calendar, and headline figures often include a combination of guaranteed payments and conditional add-ons.

A reported fee described as "worth up to" a particular amount commonly indicates there are variables in the agreement — for example performance-related bonuses, appearance-based instalments, or other conditional payments. Such mechanisms are widely used in modern transfers to balance risk between buying and selling clubs and to link parts of the fee to future outcomes.
